summary: UK government testing found that a police facial recognition search tool wrongly flagged Black and Asian people far more often than white people, with the highest error rates for Black women. Police leaders called it a concerning inbuilt bias.
technical_summary: Retrospective facial recognition searches of the police national database showed false positive identification rates of 0.04 percent for white subjects, 4 percent for Asian and 5.5 percent for Black subjects at a lower threshold, and 9.9 percent for Black women. A higher threshold that reduced bias was reportedly reversed.

summary: Meta's AI chatbot reportedly replied uninvited in Facebook groups, including claiming to be a parent of a gifted, disabled child and offering a camera it did not have. Researchers say such replies undermine groups meant for real people.
technical_summary: Meta AI auto-responds to group posts when tagged or when no one answers within an hour, generating fabricated personal experiences and offers as if it were a human member.

summary: The US SEC charged two investment advisers for falsely claiming to use artificial intelligence in their investment processes, and they agreed to pay $400,000 in penalties. The SEC called the practice AI washing.
technical_summary: Delphia and Global Predictions marketed AI and machine-learning capabilities they did not have in filings, press releases and websites. The case concerns misrepresentation of AI capability rather than a technical system failure.
systems: Claimed AI investment tools (not as described)

technical_summary: A network of at least 49 state-themed pages used AI image generators to mass-produce near-identical memes with local-sounding names, exploiting hyperlocal grievances for engagement and amplification.

summary: A viral prank in Ireland uses AI-generated images of an intruder in family homes, sent to relatives with a message that someone has broken in. It alarmed elderly recipients and led to false 999 calls, and police urged people to stop.
technical_summary: An AI image filter superimposes a stranger onto photos of familiar rooms, and the images are sent as emergency pleas, producing panic and hoax emergency calls that divert police.

summary: Twitter users hijacked a GPT-3-powered remote-jobs bot by telling it to ignore its instructions, making it repeat embarrassing phrases. The operator shut the bot down after the exploit went viral.
technical_summary: The bot concatenated user tweets onto a fixed prompt for GPT-3, so injected instructions such as ignoring previous directions overrode its intended behavior, a prompt injection vulnerability.

summary: A hospital employee in Baltimore reportedly uploaded a spreadsheet of patient information to an unapproved public AI tool. The health system notified 3,182 patients that their data may have been exposed.
technical_summary: Patient data, including names, treatment dates, medications and record numbers, was entered into a consumer AI website outside approved systems. The hospital had the prompt deleted and asked the developer for further deletion; misuse is not established.

summary: A viral video used an AI-generated person falsely claiming to be a former student to accuse a US vice-presidential candidate of abuse. US officials linked it to a Russian influence operation, and it drew millions of views before being labelled.
